newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops kill gunman in south Lebanon - army.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill gunman in south Lebanon - army.

text.p: The Israeli army said on Saturday its troops killed one guerrilla and wounded several other gunmen north of Israel's self-declared security zone in south Lebanon.

"An Israeli army force operating in the western sector north of the security zone in south Lebanon (on Friday) night killed one terrorist and injured several other terrorists," a military statement said. "The Israeli forces suffered no casualties."

On May 15 pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas killed three Israeli soldiers and wounded seven in a fierce clash in south Lebanon. Israeli aircraft launched several attacks on south Lebanon over the next three days.
Israeli forces, backed by the South Lebanon Army militia, occupy a 15 km (nine-mile) -wide zone in south Lebanon.
